origin: SMD-3662's dogfood set: one row per "what next" session against the maintainer's brains, recorded at the time and never rewritten once the board moves (evals/eval-priority.ts prints them beside the seeded table).
note: Fields are ids and numbers only (check 9, SMD-1295), the session's prompt under query, prose under note. date is YYYYMMDD. pick is the SMD ticket's number the live board gave and the operator took up; picked_instead is the one the brains put first. thought is the stable thought that records the session. A read's rank is where it put the pick: a number from 1, 0 when it was not in the read's results, null when the session did not record it. evals/priority.ts's dogfoodProblems holds the shape.

rows.query: highest value unstarted open brain issue? compare answers from stable, canary, and you
